name: Sriracha
siboNotes: Contains garlic which is high in fructans and should be avoided during SIBO treatment phases. Even small amounts can trigger symptoms in sensitive individuals.
preparationTips: Check labels as some brands may contain additional high-FODMAP ingredients like onion powder
Start with very small amounts (1/4 teaspoon) if testing tolerance
Consider making homemade version with garlic-infused oil instead of garlic
Store in refrigerator after opening to maintain flavor and safety
alternatives: Red pepper flakes with olive oil
Tabasco or other vinegar-based hot sauces
Homemade chili sauce with scallion greens
nutritionalHighlights: Contains capsaicin which may boost metabolism
Low in calories (about 5 calories per teaspoon)
Provides small amounts of vitamin C from chili peppers
Contains vinegar which may aid digestion
